test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following players is associated with billiards?
solution:
The correct answer is **Pankaj Advani**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Pankaj Advani is related to Billiards and Snooker.
 
• He won the world championship 23 times and also the winner of the IBSF world snooker championship 15 times.
 
• He was born on 24th July 1986 at Pune, Maharashtra.
 
• He is known as " Prince Boy of India " and "The Golden boy".
 
• He was awarded as Padma Bhushan in 2018 and Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna in 2005 and 2006.
 
• Padma Shri in 2009 and Arjuna award in 2004.
 
• He is champion in Billiards and Snooker.
 
• He is the first Indian to the won world championship in the 6-red snooker.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Neeraj Chopra

 
• Neeraj Chopra is originally from Khandra village in Panipat, Haryana. 
 
• He was born on 24 December 1997. His father Satish Kumar is a farmer.
 
• Neeraj Chopra is an Indian Track and field athlete and a Junior Commissioned Officer in Indian Army.
 
• The distance reached by the javelin in the gold medal-winning throw by Neeraj Chopra at the Olympic games held in Tokyo in 2021 lay between 87.5 m and 88.0 m.
 
• Tokyo Olympics: India's Neeraj Chopra won the gold medal in the men's javelin throw event with a throw of 87.58m in his second attempt.
 
• Neeraj is the first Indian in over 120 years, and the first athlete from independent India, to win an Olympic medal in a track-and-field discipline.
 
• Chopra also became the sixth Indian athlete to win an individual medal at Tokyo 2020 joining weightlifter Mirabai Chanu, shuttler PV Sindhu, boxer Lovlina Borgohain, and wrestlers Ravi Kumar Dahiya and Bajrang Punia.

**Sankalp Gupta**:

 
• Sankalp Gupta has become India's 71st Grandmaster by scoring 6.5 points and finishing second in the GM Ask 3 round-robin event in Arandjelovac, Serbia.
 
• Gupta secured the three required GM norms in just 24 days by playing three tournaments on the trot.
 
• In all the three events, his rating performances were at 2599 and above.

**Manish Narwal:**

 
• Manish Narwal (born 17 October 2001) is an Indian Para Pistol Shooter.
 
• He ranks fourth in the world in Men's 10m Air Pistol SH1 according to the World Shooting Para Sports Rankings.
 
• Manish is also supported by GoSports Foundation through the Para Champions Programme.
 
• Shooting has inspired competition, and in several countries, rifle clubs started to form in the 19th century.
